headline: Executive order allows the US to impose sanctions on people seen as destabilizing Sudan or blocking its move toward democracy.
what_it_does: This executive order, signed by President Biden on May 4, 2023, sets up a way for the US government to place sanctions on certain people tied to instability in Sudan. It targets those viewed as undermining Sudan's transition to a democratic government. Only the title was provided, so the specific details of who can be targeted and what the sanctions involve are not covered here.

who_it_affects.group: People and groups linked to instability in Sudan
who_it_affects.how: They can face US sanctions under this order.
They may be limited in dealing with anyone placed under these sanctions.
